title: PBA admits wrong call in Ginebra-San Miguel Game 4, suspends ref

blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—The PBA acknowledged it made an erroneous call in Game 4 of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals between Barangay Ginebra and San Miguel Beer, and said it has suspended one of its referees for the remainder of the playoffs. Commissioner Willie Marcial said that the official, whom he did not name, should have called a travelling on the Beermen’s George King instead of a foul on the Gin Kings’ Scottie Thompson during the waning moments of the previous game held Friday at Smart Araneta Coliseum.
